records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.LoadingScreen#1
records.source: By default it shows the white mark beside the strap line. Once :meth:`show_mosaic` is called it shows only the spaCR photomosaic, with no text or lines beneath it. :meth:`blow_away` ends it by blowing the mosaic's tiles off the window to reveal the window underneath.
records.context: By default it shows the white mark beside the strap line. Once :meth:`show_mosaic` is called it shows only the spaCR photomosaic, with no text or lines beneath it. :meth:`blow_away` ends it by blowing the stitched image grid's microscope image fields off the window to reveal the window underneath.
records.translation: Sjálfgefið sýnir hún hvíta merkið við hlið slagorðslínunnar. Þegar :meth:`show_mosaic` hefur verið kallað sýnir hún aðeins ljósmyndamósaík spaCR, án texta eða lína fyrir neðan. :meth:`blow_away` bindur enda á hana með því að blása flísum mósaíksins af glugganum til að afhjúpa gluggann undir.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#14
records.source: Additional segmentation tools are opened from the masthead in :data:`FOLD_ORDER` through :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. **Mask folder** applies Cellpose to every lowercase ``.tif`` image in the selected folder, while **Save mask** on the Curate page calls :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. Folded modules retain their existing widgets inside :class:`FoldedModulePanel`.
records.context: Additional segmentation tools are opened from the masthead in :data:`FOLD_ORDER` through :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. **Mask folder** applies Cellpose to every lowercase ``.tif`` image in the selected folder, while **Save mask** on the Curate page calls :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. Folded modules retain their existing widgets inside :class:`FoldedModulePanel`.
records.translation: Fleiri skiptingarverkfæri eru opnuð úr hausnum í :data:`FOLD_ORDER` í gegnum :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. **Búa til maska fyrir möppu** beitir Cellpose á hverja mynd með lágstafaendingunni ``.tif`` í valinni möppu, en **Save mask** á Curate-síðunni kallar á :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. Samanbrotnar einingar halda fyrirliggjandi græjum sínum innan :class:`FoldedModulePanel`.
